items.title: Fake news game confers psychological resistance against online misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In a novel attempt to address this issue, we designed a psychological intervention in the form of an online browser game. In the game, players take on the role of a fake news producer and learn to master six documented techniques commonly used in the production of misinformation
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a large-scale evaluation of the game with N = 15,000 participants in a pre-post gameplay design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico utilizando o jogo Bad News, que é um exemplo citado no pedido. O método (pré e pós-jogo) e o tamanho da amostra estão corretamente identificados no resumo. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: Good News about Bad News: Gamified Inoculation Boosts Confidence and Cognitive Immunity Against Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: A recent example is the Bad News game, an online fake news game in which players learn about six common misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a 2 (treatment vs. control) × 2 (pre vs. post) mixed design (N = 196) we measure participants’ ability to spot misinformation techniques in 18 fake headlines before and after playing Bad News.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento controlado com um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) para combater desinformação, sem focar nos temas excluídos. O método e o achado estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Prebunking interventions based on the psychological theory of "inoculation" can reduce susceptibility to misinformation across cultures

judge.evidence_topic: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies
judge.evidence_empirical: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies... we find that “prebunking” or preemptively warning and exposing people to weakened doses of misinformation can help cultivate “mental antibodies” against fake news.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News e é empírico. Contudo, o resumo não menciona o método (pré e pós-teste), logo a informação sobre o método não é confirmada pelo resumo.

items.title: Long-term effectiveness of inoculation against misinformation: Three longitudinal experiments

judge.evidence_topic: We tested the effectiveness of Bad News, a real-world intervention in which participants develop resistance against misinformation through exposure to weakened doses of misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using 3 longitudinal experiments (2 preregistered), we tested the effectiveness of Bad News... In 3 experiments (NExp1 = 151, NExp2 = 194, NExp3 = 170), participants played either Bad News (inoculation group) or Tetris (gamified control group)
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (três experimentos) sobre o jogo Bad News, que é um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, não se enquadrando nas exclusões (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política). Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Disentangling Item and Testing Effects in Inoculation Research on Online Misinformation: Solomon Revisited

judge.evidence_topic: This study addresses two unanswered methodological questions about a widely adopted online “fake news” inoculation game, Bad News.
judge.evidence_empirical: We investigate both item and testing effects in two online studies (total N = 2,159) using the Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News, que é o foco do pedido, e não aborda os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O estudo é empírico (dois estudos online), o método (Solomon's Three Group Design) está correto e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Technique-based inoculation against real-world misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments
judge.reason: O artigo descreve dois experimentos utilizando o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação, o que está alinhado com o pedido. Não há menção aos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições, política). O método e o achado extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Game-based inoculation versus graphic-based inoculation to combat misinformation: a randomized controlled trial

judge.evidence_topic: This study employed inoculation theory and developed an interactive game to help the public counter misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 180 Chinese participants were randomly assigned to game-based inoculation, graphic-based inoculation, and control groups.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) que avalia um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, sem focar nos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições). O método e o achado extraídos estão alinhados com o resumo.

items.title: Gamified Inoculation Against Misinformation in India: A Randomized Control Trial

judge.evidence_topic: We report the results of a game-based intervention against misinformation in India.
judge.evidence_empirical: The present study conducted in north India (n = 757) did not replicate earlier findings.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) sobre uma intervenção gamificada de inoculação contra desinformação na Índia, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O achado de efeito nulo está claramente descrito no resumo.

items.title: Feedback exercises boost discernment of misinformation for gamified inoculation interventions

judge.evidence_topic: Gamification is a promising approach to reducing misinformation susceptibility. Previous research has found that 'inoculation' games such as Bad News and Harmony Square help build cognitive resistance against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We address these issues in two preregistered lab experiments (N1 = 191, N2 = 321) and four quasi-experimental in-game surveys implemented in Harmony Square (N3 = 559) and Bad News (N4 = 2,558, N5 = 419, N6 = 882).
judge.reason: O artigo investiga jogos de inoculação (Bad News e Harmony Square) através de experimentos e quase-experimentos, atendendo aos critérios de tema e método. O achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: How to "inoculate" against multimodal misinformation: A conceptual replication of Roozenbeek and van der Linden (2020)

judge.evidence_topic: We developed a game called Cat Park , in which players learn about five manipulation techniques (trolling, emotional manipulation, amplification, polarization, and conspiracism), and how misinformation can spread through images.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game’s efficacy, we conducted a conceptual replication ( N = 380) of Roozenbeek and van der Linden’s 2020 study about Harmony Square , with the same study design, item set, and hypotheses.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento) com um jogo de inoculação (Cat Park) contra desinformação, atendendo aos critérios. O achado extraído reflete fielmente os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Mixed News about the Bad News Game

judge.evidence_topic: four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.
judge.evidence_empirical: four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.

items.title: Effects of inductive learning and gamification on news veracity discernment

judge.evidence_topic: Participants (N = 282 Prolific users) were randomly assigned to either a gamified IL intervention, a nongamified version of the same IL intervention, a no-treatment control group, or a Bad News intervention, a notable web-based game designed to tackle online misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: This preregistered study tests a novel psychological intervention to improve news veracity discernment. ... judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento com participantes que avalia o jogo Bad News, atendendo aos critérios de tema e método. O achado extraído é uma representação precisa do resultado relatado no resumo.

items.title: Playing an Augmented Reality Escape Game Promotes Learning About Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education.
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education. To overcome this gap, we conducted a field study using a pretest-posttest research design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré-teste e pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para letramento midiático, sem violar as restrições de tema (não é sobre COVID, vacinas ou política). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Can pre-service teachers learn about fake news by playing an augmented reality escape game?

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of this study is to address this gap by examining whether pre-service teachers can learn about fake news using the augmented reality escape game Escape Fake.
judge.evidence_empirical: To investigate this question, a pre-/post-test design was conducted with 45 pre-service teachers
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré/pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para combater desinformação, sem violar as restrições de tema (política, vacinas, etc.). O método e o achado estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Effekte eines Augmented Reality Escape Games auf das Lernen über Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In dieser Studie wird untersucht, ob auch ein Augmented-Reality-basiertes Escape Game Lernziele adressieren kann, die für den Unterricht über Fake News relevant sind.
judge.evidence_empirical: Um diese Frage zu beantworten, wurde ein Vortest-Nachtest Design mit 27 Schüler:innen durchgeführt.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré e pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) focado em fake news, sem violar as restrições de tema (não é sobre COVID, vacinas ou política). O achado extraído reflete fielmente o que está no resumo.

items.title: Enhancing Information Literacy for Spotting Fake News: A Study on the Efficacy of a Serious Game for M-Learning Across Different Age Groups

judge.evidence_topic: the goal of this research is to propose a serious game design for learning to evaluate sources using the CRAAP test.
judge.evidence_empirical: To evaluate the game, we did a randomized online field study, including quantitative research based on pre-posttests involving 351 participants.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (randomized online field study) sobre um jogo educativo para letramento informacional, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Investigating the long-term impact of misinformation interventions in upper secondary education

judge.evidence_topic: Using an experimental design with 459 students in authentic classroom settings, we tested three types of interventions: prebunking through the Bad News game
judge.evidence_empirical: Using an experimental design with 459 students in authentic classroom settings

items.title: Active inoculation boosts attitudinal resistance against extremist persuasion techniques: a novel approach towards the prevention of violent extremism

judge.evidence_topic: we developed and tested a novel online game, Radicalise , which aims to combat the effectiveness of online recruitment strategies used by extremist organizations, based on the principles of active psychological inoculation.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game's effectiveness, we conducted a preregistered 2 × 2 mixed (pre–post) randomized controlled experiment ( n = 291)
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento randomizado) sobre um jogo de inoculação (Radicalise) contra técnicas de recrutamento extremista, o que se enquadra no tema de jogos de inoculação (prebunking) e não viola as restrições de exclusão (COVID, vacinas, eleições, política partidária). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Inoculating against extremist persuasion techniques – Results from a randomised controlled trial in post-conflict areas in Iraq

judge.evidence_topic: We conducted a field experiment (N = 191) in post-conflict regions of Iraq to assess the effectiveness of a short inoculation game, Radicalise, in improving vulnerable individuals’ resistance against extremist manipulation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a field experiment (N = 191) in post-conflict regions of Iraq to assess the effectiveness of a short inoculation game, Radicalise, in improving vulnerable individuals’ resistance against extremist manipulation techniques.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento de campo com um jogo de inoculação (Radicalise) para combater técnicas de persuasão extremista, o que se enquadra no tema. O método e o tamanho da amostra estão corretamente descritos e o achado principal reflete fielmente os resultados estatísticos apresentados no resumo.

judge.evidence_topic: This study aims to validate the contribution of the game Follow me in building resilience to fake news through an experiment on a sample of 130 secondary school students from six different schools.
judge.evidence_empirical: This study aims to validate the contribution of the game Follow me in building resilience to fake news through an experiment on a sample of 130 secondary school students from six different schools.

items.title: MAthE the Game: A Serious Game for Education and Training in News Verification

judge.evidence_topic: The game presents news articles, which have to be characterized as fake or real by the players. The findings suggest that educational games may be a promising vehicle to inoculate the public against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: After presenting the progress of interface design and development, this paper reports the results of a randomized online field study (n = 111), which provides some preliminary evidence.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo educativo para verificação de notícias, enquadrando-se no tema de inoculação contra desinformação. O estudo é empírico (randomizado) e os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Inoculation against conspiracy theories: A consumer side approach to India's fake news problem

judge.evidence_topic: We attempt to replicate Roozenbeek and van der Linden's Western‐based study in India by employing the Bad News Game , an online game, in which players take on the role of a misinformation tycoon.
judge.evidence_empirical: We test the game's impact on an Indian sample ( n = 1002) using a within‐subject design.
judge.reason: O artigo utiliza o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação em uma amostra indiana, o que está alinhado ao pedido. O estudo é empírico, com desenho intra-sujeitos e amostra de 1002 participantes. O achado principal extraído é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Chaos creator: Misinformation inoculation in information literacy instruction

judge.evidence_topic: The prebunking techniques are delivered through a competitive game called Chaos Creator, based on the Bad News game developed by researchers at Cambridge University.
judge.evidence_empirical: Via a quasi-experimental study, this research explores the effect of prebunking techniques in an IL instruction session on undergraduate students’ ability to recognise misinformation.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo quase-experimental utilizando um jogo de inoculação (Chaos Creator) para combater desinformação, o que se alinha perfeitamente aos critérios de inclusão. O achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Bad News in the civics classroom: How serious gameplay fosters teenagers' ability to discern misinformation techniques

judge.evidence_topic: Although the serious game Bad News has been used to inoculate citizens against misinformation, it has not been formally evaluated in traditional classrooms. We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students
judge.evidence_empirical: we therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class.
